components.css: .ds-camera{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border,#343b39);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface,#1a1e1e);color:#eceeef;font:14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-head{padding:10px 16px;min-height:40px;display:flex;align-items:center}.ds-video{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#0b0e0d;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted,#adb8b3)}.ds-camera details{padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#adb8b3)}.ds-camera summary{cursor:pointer}.ds-camera summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#d7e8df);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: Dark smart-camera monitoring with rounded charcoal surfaces, lime selection, and restrained interface chrome. Camera imagery carries the main visual weight; a compact alert feed provides adjacent evidence access. This direction follows the user-supplied monitoring references.
dos: Use actual camera names, statuses, and evidence.
Keep video prominent and alerts compact.
Pair warning colors with readable status text.
Preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not add a pause control or redundant review link to the monitor.
Do not promote diagnostic values or long explanations into the primary monitoring view.
Do not imply verified compliance or cross-camera identity.
Do not invent site names, benchmarks, or brand promises.
